name: Princess Puikoru: A Space Time Vendetta
storyline: Puikoru ( the princess of the Planet Kanosumi ) was casually enjoying her day, until a enemy force called the League Of Intuition, invaded her planet with the leader killing her parents and seizing absolute power. Having narrowly escaped death, Puikoru ( after months of hiding ) begins her journey to exterminate the ones who are running the League of Intuition, and to find out the truth about why all of this even happened.
